newsitem.title: USA: North American bunkers up, Houston barge mishap.
newsitem.headline: North American bunkers up, Houston barge mishap.

text.p: North American bunker prices were mostly higher late this week amid an increase in demand and tight supplies, players said on Thursday.
In the East Coast, demand increased in New York Harbor, pushing up prices by about $5 to between $98 and $99 a tonne. 180 CST was pegged $4 higher from Tuesday at $103/104 a tonne.

Values in the Gulf Coast also rose about $5 partially due to suppliers trying to increase their prices, although buyers did not follow. Shipping was also restricted Thursday on the Houston Ship Channel because of a capsized barge, which could have impacted prices, players said.
